guidelines.detail: same as LRN-015 (The description says the CRS hands out a repair cost calculation, while the generated label says to prepare one. That changes the represented action, unlike the other cited task-label pairs, which align with the described activities. LRN-015 already instructs preserving materially stated actions and not substituting a different action.)

documentation rule FID-02 not applied (The description identifies checking and configuring software, and checking and repairing hardware, as distinct actions. The generated labels combine each pair, while the reference represents them separately. This is the same modeling issue already addressed by FID-02, which says not to merge separately described actions into one task.)

same as LRN-048 (The description explicitly states the participant’s action before the subsequent work. The generated start events and send task represent that action differently from the reference activity, so this is an element-choice issue rather than an absent action. LRN-048 already expresses the same guideline.)

documentation rule FID-02 not applied (The description distinguishes checking from configuring and checking from repairing, while the generated labels combine those actions. The documented guideline FID-02 already says not to merge separately described actions into one task, so this guideline is not new.)

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description identifies multiple required activities within a phase, requires all of them before that phase can end, and specifies no order among them: Model the activities as parallel branches synchronized by a parallel gateway.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states that multiple required activities may occur in any order and that all must be completed before a later activity can proceed

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description names an activity or outcome with multiple stated actions, alternatives, or a distinguishing object or participant.: Label the corresponding BPMN activity or event so its described scope remains identifiable. Preserve materially stated actions, alternatives, and objects or participants; do not substitute a broader or different action or add unsupported details.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states an activity using a specific action and object, and the generated task label substitutes a materially different action

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description requires every activity in a set to be completed but does not prescribe their order: Model the activities as parallel branches and synchronize them before any activity that depends on completion of the entire set.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description requires every activity in a set to be completed but does not prescribe their order

rules_sent_back.instruction: Do not merge separately described actions into one task or split one stated action without a process reason. Preserve described dependencies.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description presents multiple distinct actions as components of an activity

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description explicitly states an action performed by a participant before subsequent process work: Model that action as a BPMN activity and include it in the sequence flow.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states that a participant performs an identifiable action before subsequent process work
